text.value: Welcome to WW2 Undead mode! In this mode you win by securing the Castle, located on the map in the area with No Recon. The Castle Gate is locked, and can only be opened by interacting with occult pentagrams scattered across the map, located within the bases. Also, any time you die, you can select an available parachute spawn node.
Certain heavier ENEMY VEHICLES in EDELWEISS and PACIFIC cannot be stolen. This is done entirely for balance and gameplay reasons. Other lighter vehicles can still be stolen!

BAYONETS can be toggled in EDELWEISS and PACIFIC. Weapons with two dots at the bottom of their icon can do this. They can be toggled by pressing %control_next_weapon_in_chain. Bayonets greatly extend your melee range but at the cost of some accuracy.

In EDELWEISS, most fences can be destroyed by EXPLOSIVES or driven over by most VEHICLES. Additionally, Hedgerows can be destroyed by DEMOLITIONS CHARGES as well as crushed by special vehicles such as the Sherman RHINO.
Enemy BOSS TANKS must be killed through any means necessary in order to secure VICTORY on certain maps. They have additional health and a lot of firepower to make your task a challenge!

PILLBOXES can be encountered in PACIFIC and are heavily fortified machinegun positions. They are not very vulnerable to standard Grenades, but take a lot of damage from HEAVY EXPLOSIVES and FLAMETHROWERS.

title.value: Radio Jammers, Coastal Guns, AA Guns

text.value: Enemy RADIO JAMMERS will block your ability to use any call-ins in a certain area around it. They are vulnerable to DEMOLITIONS CHARGES if you can get close enough. COASTAL GUNS and AA GUNS block specific call-ins on the entire map, and destroying them will grant you powerful NAVAL ARTILLERY and AIRPOWER respectively.

You can order the Bergetiger to stop for a short time by pressing %control_shoot when aiming at it. Also repairing it with a wrench will cause it to stop.%PSThis can also be used tactically to slow down the convoy in order to regroup your troops
